# local-codebase-indexer

> Local codebase indexer and context provider for AI coding assistants. MCP server and CLI, SQLite storage, no cloud. Understands C#, Python, JS/TS and T-SQL, including which code reads or writes a table or stored procedure.

Install: `pip install local-codebase-indexer`, then `local-codebase-indexer --root <project> index`.

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): install, commands, MCP registration, how to read confidence levels
- [README.md](README.md): features, design, known limits
- [TODO.md](TODO.md): planned work
- [benchmarks/README.md](benchmarks/README.md): how search quality is measured
